map.从若干轮损失中选出最优轮次。: Select the best epoch from several rounds of loss.
map.取验证损失最低的轮次而非最后一轮，是早停的标准做法。若多个轮次损失接近，优先选更: Choosing the epoch with the lowest validation loss rather than the last epoch is the standard early-stopping practice. If several epochs have close losses, prefer a later one (usually more stable) or re-filter by a secondary metric (F1); note that "selecting the epoch on the validation set" is itself slightly optimistic, so a strict evaluation should reserve an independent test set.
map.应结合验证集，避免过拟合轮次。: Combine with the validation set to avoid overfit epochs.
map.在记录中各轮验证指标(如验证 loss/F1)取最优轮次，作为部署权重。: Among the records, pick the epoch with the best validation metric (e.g. validation loss/F1) as the deployed weights.
map.监控指标上升即早停，并回退到最佳轮 checkpoint，避免用: Stop early once the metric rises and roll back to the best-epoch checkpoint, avoiding using
map.若多指标冲突(如 loss 最低但 F1 非最高)，按业务优先级选定主指标。: If multiple metrics conflict (e.g. lowest loss but not highest F1), choose the primary metric by business priority.

map.用 loss 还是 F1 选最佳轮？: Use loss or F1 to pick the best epoch?
map.看目标。回归用验证 loss/RMSE；分类常看 F1/Accuracy；若关注: It depends on the goal. Regression uses validation loss/RMSE; classification often looks at F1/Accuracy; if the false-negative rate matters, look at precision. The primary metric should directly map to business value.
map.验证指标波动怎么选？: How to choose when validation metrics fluctuate?
map.取平滑后的最优且要求持续优势(patience)，避免单点噪声误导；也可在最佳轮: Take the smoothed optimum and require a sustained lead (patience) to avoid single-point noise; you can also run a few extra validations near the best epoch to confirm stability.
map.最佳轮次判定（argmin 完整口径）：最小验证损失 minLoss = min: Best-epoch determination (full argmin basis): minimum validation loss minLoss = min(l₁…l₅); best epoch = the index found by a linear scan for the minimum (strict comparison a[i]<a[m] keeps the earlier epoch on ties, index+1 is the epoch number). Validation: no strict checks; empty validation losses count as 0. Grading: no tiers; minLoss keeps 4 decimals and the best epoch is an integer.
map.早停判读口径：最佳轮次 = 五轮验证损失中最小者所在轮；损失随轮次递减说明仍在收: Early-stop interpretation: best epoch = the epoch with the smallest of the five validation losses; a loss decreasing with epochs means still converging and training may continue; once it bottoms out and rises there is an overfitting turning point, so early-stop and roll back to that epoch's weights (taking the earlier epoch on ties is safer). Validation: no strict checks; unfilled losses count as 0. Grading: no fixed tiers; the best epoch also gauges generalization — training loss still falling while validation loss rises means generalization has begun to degrade.
